title: Human vs Machine Translation Detection: A Cross-Model, Cross-Domain, and Low-Resource Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.18586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing reliance on web-crawled corpora for training large language models introduces a critical challenge: machine-translated (MT) content is often treated as human translation (HT), potentially degrading data quality and propagating synthetic artifacts, especially in low-resource settings. In this work, we study MT-HT detectability across high-resource (English, Spanish) and low-resource (Swahili, Afrikaans) languages using both decoder-only LLMs in zero-shot and few-shot settings, and fine-tuned multilingual encoders trained at the sentence level and on token-chunked inputs. We find that decoder-only models provide limited discrimination overall and exhibit a consistent class-asymmetric failure mode: they recognize human-written text reliably (high HT recall) but rarely flag fluent machine output (low MT recall). Encoder-based classifiers achieve high accuracy when evaluated on data generated by the same MT systems and translators

translated_title: 人类翻译与机器翻译检测：跨模型、跨领域与低资源分析
translated_abstract: 训练大型语言模型对网络爬取语料的日益依赖带来了一个关键挑战：机器翻译（MT）内容常被当作人工翻译（HT）处理，这可能降低数据质量并传播合成痕迹，尤其是在低资源场景下。在这项工作中，我们研究了高资源语言（英语、西班牙语）和低资源语言（斯瓦希里语、南非荷兰语）中机器翻译与人工翻译的可检测性，采用了零样本和少样本设置下的仅解码器大语言模型，以及在句子级别和分词块输入上训练的微调多语言编码器。我们发现，仅解码器模型的整体判别能力有限，并表现出一种一致的类不对称失效模式：它们能够可靠地识别人工撰写的文本（高HT召回率），却很少标记流畅的机器输出（低MT召回率）。基于编码器的分类器在由相同机器翻译系统和翻译器生成的数据上进行评估时能够达到高准确率。
tldr: 本研究跨模型、跨领域、跨语言系统分析了机器翻译与人工翻译的可检测性，发现仅解码器大模型虽能可靠识别人工翻译却几乎无法检出机器翻译，而编码器分类器仅在相同翻译系统的数据上表现优异，揭示了低资源语言网页语料中数据质量退化与合成痕迹传播的风险。
en_tdlr: This study systematically analyzes MT-vs-HT detectability across models, domains, and languages, showing that decoder-only LLMs reliably recognize human translations but rarely flag machine translations, while encoder-based classifiers achieve high accuracy only on data from the same MT systems, highlighting data-quality risks in low-resource web corpora.
